visualCharacteristics: rc11: Light grey (#f6f7fb) title banner; centered orange H2 "The Avanade Story", centered paragraph and "Learn more about us" link. Image-less centered title banner: heading, paragraph and link only.

contentPattern.authoring: Optional background picture row, then one row with heading, paragraph and CTA link. Split option: one content cell with a heading and paragraphs; the heading renders left and everything after it right (stacked on mobile).

cells: H2, paragraphs (split option: heading renders left, the rest right)

usage.description: Image-less centered title banner: heading, paragraph and link.

reuseGuidance: Use for section-intro banners with no media. Use hero-video-badge for the page hero.
